review_candidates.title: Network Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: What You'll Do- Implement, maintain, and support our enterprise network, including firewalls, switching, wireless, and WAN/SD-WAN/SASE. Administer Aruba CX switching and wireless (Aruba Central) across corporate and branch locations, while supporting our remaining Cisco gear during the transition. Systematic troubleshooting skills and a calm head under pressure. Physical Requirements- Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer, including video conferencing.
eligibility_evidence: Location: The successful candidate will work on-site at our Home Offices in the Greater Seattle area .
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: As a Network Engineer on our IT Infrastructure team, you'll help keep MOE connected and secure, working hands-on with Palo Alto firewalls, Aruba switching and wireless, SASE, and cloud connectivity across Azure and AWS. You'll learn alongside senior engineers, contribute to real modernization projects, and build deep expertise in network security and cloud networking along the way. What You Bring- Hands-on experience with Palo Alto firewalls (PAN-OS, Panorama) and Strata Cloud (Prisma Access, GlobalProtect). Education & Experience- 3–5 years of enterprise networking experience in a production environment Proven production experience with Palo Alto firewalls and Aruba switching and wireless (required). Physical Requirements- Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer, including video conferencing.
